messages:
Maya (AE): Sending MeridianHealth RFI bundle at 16:00 PT. Quick sanity check? Need ops diagram + short security caveats in the main PDF.
Liam (Solutions): Which files are we attaching now?
Maya (AE): capability_matrix_final.xlsx, meridian-rfi-answers.pdf, pricing-commits.csv, poc-2options.md, ops-runbook-excerpt.txt, security-caveats.txt
Priya (Security): Request: include BYOK statement + a one-line on audit logs and key rotation. Also flag that FedRAMP wasn't requested but note controls mapping offer.
Omar (Ops): Ops ask: add a network peering sketch and expected egress per day for the 3-week PoC. Also note we need their cloud account IDs for quota checks.
Liam (Solutions): I'll add a 'fallback-model' column to the capability matrix and a short caveat cell for quantized variants.
Maya (AE): Good. Priya, can you paste a 2-sentence blurb we can drop into meridian-rfi-answers.pdf?
Priya (Security): Blurb: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys via standard KMS integrations (AWS/GCP/Azure). For Private deployments we support HSM-backed key storage with documented rotation and audit logs; hosted BYOK is provided through our KMS bridge. We can produce a controls-mapping for compliance inquiries."
Omar (Ops): I'll add gating item to poc-2options.md: "Week 0: provide account IDs + IAM role for provisioning; infra quota confirmation required to start." Also uploading peering-diagram.png to the repo.
rfi-bot: Files uploaded to Meridian repo: capability_matrix_final.xlsx, meridian-rfi-answers.pdf, pricing-commits.csv, poc-2options.md, ops-runbook-excerpt.txt, security-caveats.txt, peering-diagram.png. SHA256: b4f2...e7c.
Liam (Solutions): Example snippet for their embed pipeline to include in PoC appendix:
```
model: redwood-micro-1
quantize: int8
batch_target: 512
enable_prefix_cache: true
```
Maya (AE): Thanks all. Action list: Priya finalize controls-mapping start, Omar confirm diagram upload and gating note, Liam finalize matrix column and pricing example. I'll send at 16:00 sharp. :thumbsup:
